paragraphs: My name is Tom, and I am twelve years old. Our family has a group in a chat app on the phone. Grandma and Grandpa use it too. They live in Green Hill, a small village near the town. On Thursday, Grandma sent a message. It said, "Come to Green Hill on Saturday. The bus leaves the town station at nine o'clock. Grandpa will wait at the bus stop. I will make a big cake." Several other messages came after that.

Mom wrote, "We will come! Should we bring some food?" Grandma answered, "No, I will cook lunch." Lily wrote, "I am so excited!" Dad asked, "Should Pip come too?" "Yes," wrote Grandma, "but he must stay on his lead." I wrote, "What time do we come home?" Grandma wrote, "Come back on the five o'clock bus."

Then Grandpa sent a photo. It was an old picture of two young people in front of a house. Grandpa wrote, "This is my wife and me on the day we were married." "Look at Grandma's smile!" wrote Lily. Grandma wrote, "Grandpa, you are not so young now!" We laughed at the phone. Everyone in the family liked the photo. Mom said, "Pack your bags tonight."

On Saturday, we took the bus at nine o'clock. Pip sat on Lily's feet and did not move. At the Green Hill bus stop, Grandpa waited with a big smile. Grandma stood at the gate with the cake. "Welcome, everyone," she said. The village was green and quiet. A message in an app is short, but it says when and where.
